description: Optional plant/system geometry used internally to establish defaults for existing FLARE model parameters. Missing values fall back to power-scaled generic_smr geometry or legacy defaults.
units: SI unless a field name states otherwise

scaling_policy.fallback: Scale extensive reference quantities linearly with total thermal power.
scaling_policy.design_adjustment: When model power differs from a design reference power, lengths scale with power^(1/3), diameter-derived areas with power^(2/3), and extensive volumes/flows/inventories with power.
scaling_policy.pump_rated_flow: Use selected design documented total rated flow, multiplied by modeled_power/reference_power. Never use another design as a pump-flow surrogate. If missing, warn and use the unscaled FLARE legacy rated flow.
scaling_policy.plant_geometry: Do not power-scale plant geometry, volumes, areas, or inventories.
